headlines.title: Why Charter Communications Stock Is Back In Focus After $2 Billion Cost Saving Plan
headlines.summary: Charter Communications recently reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$14.922b alongside a shareholder loss of US$2.397b that was mainly driven by a US$6.326b non cash franchise impairment, while also outlining an Internet first operating model and integration progress following the Cox Communications acquisition.

headlines.title: Charter Communications (CHTR) Jumps After Cox Deal, Is It Still Cheap?
headlines.summary: Why Charter Communications Is Back On Radar After Q3 And Cox Deal Charter Communications (CHTR) is back in focus after an over 8% single day move, fueled by fresh reactions to its recent Cox Communications acquisition and mixed third quarter update. The jump in trading followed a sharp pickup in retail discussion, with online chatter about Charter Communications climbing 154% and sentiment shifting from neutral to bullish in a short window.

headlines.title: CHTR Stock Posts 2nd Consecutive Day Of Gains: Retail Turns Bullish — 'The Gift That Keeps On Giving'
headlines.summary: Retail sentiment around Charter Communications stock jumped from ‘neutral’ to ‘bullish’ over 24 hours, a marked improvement from the ‘bearish’ territory it was in a week ago.

headlines.title: Charter Communications (CHTR) Stock Is Up 7.4% Today Without Company News
headlines.summary: On Wednesday, Nov. 25, the shares rose 7.4% without company-specific news as the S&P 500 fell 1.

headlines.title: Charter Communications Stock: Analyst Estimates & Ratings
headlines.summary: Charter Communications has significantly trailed the broader market over the past year, and analysts are cautious about the stock’s prospects.

description: Charter Communications, Inc. operates as a broadband connectivity company in the United States. The company offers subscription-based internet, mobile, video, and voice services; broadband connectivity services, including fixed internet, WiFi, and mobile; Spectrum internet products; advanced WiFi services; and in-home WiFi, which provides customers with high performance wireless routers and managed WiFi services to enhance their wireless internet experience. It also offers wireline voice communications services using voice over internet protocol technology; Call Guard, an advanced caller ID and robocall blocking solution; video programming and video services, including access to an interactive programming guide with parental controls, video on demand and pay-per-view services; and broadband communications solutions, such as internet access, data networking, fiber connectivity, video entertainment, and business telephone services. In addition, the company provides advertising services on cable television networks, various streaming services, and advertising platforms for local, regional and national businesses. Further, it offers production and technical services for regional sports networks; owns and manages local news channels, including Spectrum News NY1® and Spectrum News SoCal; and delivers broadband connectivity solutions to apartments, single-family gated communities, off-campus student housing, senior residences, and RV parks. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
